fusions.name: Scenting the Wound
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Churned Water
fusions.desc: You churn the water around you, dealing 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Chum Frenzy
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Taste Remembered
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
